# Avemeo API & AI Connector (MCP)

> Avemeo is a cloud platform (CMS) for digital signage, hotel TV (hospitality IPTV) and in-store audio/video, developed by Avemeo s.r.o. This repository documents the Avemeo REST API (OpenAPI 3, 380+ operations) and the Avemeo AI connector – a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and other MCP-compatible AI assistants manage screens, playlists, schedulers and players with the user's permissions and approval before every change. Maintained by SORTEC EUROPE s.r.o., distributor and business & development partner of Avemeo in Slovakia.

Key facts:

- Clouds: Avemeo (ds.avemeo.com) and Business Stream by Slovak Telekom (cloud.tvstream.sk). Business Stream is a Slovak Telekom service that runs on the Avemeo platform.
- REST API: same API the Avemeo CMS uses; OpenAPI 3 specification at https://<cloud>/backend/openapi/; server base path /backend; sign in with POST /api/auth/login (returns {"status":"success","data":{"accessToken":"<JWT>"}}), then send Authorization: Bearer <token> and Active-Profile-Id: <account id>; remote device control uses an api-key header.
- AI connector (MCP): remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in; connector URLs at launch: https://mcp.avemeo.com/mcp (Avemeo cloud) and https://mcp.tvstream.sk/mcp (Business Stream). Status: in development, pilot with selected customers being prepared (November 2026).
- Safety model: user signs in with OAuth and chooses account and access level; every change is prepared as a plan and applied only after the user approves; deleting through AI is not available; every call is written to an audit log; content from Avemeo is treated as data, not instructions.
- Supported players: LG (webOS), Samsung and Vestel commercial displays; Android players and TVs; Raspberry Pi; ARRIS VIP4302 IPTV set-top boxes.
- Platform features: visual screen editor with widgets, templates, playlists, schedulers (weekdays, times, date ranges, holidays), interactive multi-level menus, multilingual content, hotel TV with live HLS channels and EPG, guest name and room, PMS check-in/check-out integration, Netflix/YouTube/Chromecast apps, in-store audio with proof of play, device management (power, reload, reboot, volume, screenshots, offline alerts by e-mail and SMS), kiosks, queue systems, digital menu boards.
- Languages: prompts in Slovak, Czech or English; multilingual on-screen content.
- An AI assistant built into the Avemeo CMS is also in development for customers without their own AI tool.
- Contact and pilot program: avemeo@sortec.sk; website avemeo.sk.
- Documentation license: CC BY 4.0. Avemeo is a trademark of Avemeo s.r.o.; Business Stream is a service of Slovak Telekom, a.s.
